final: WITH station_phase AS (SELECT t.observstation AS station, o.lunarstage AS moon_phase, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bw, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage), phase_stats AS (SELECT moon_phase, AVG(avg_bw) AS avg_of_avgs, SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM station_phase GROUP BY moon_phase), grand AS (SELECT SUM(total_cnt) AS grand_total FROM phase_stats) SELECT p.moon_phase, p.avg_of_avgs, p.total_cnt, 1.0 * p.total_cnt / g.grand_total AS share FROM phase_stats p JOIN grand g ON g.grand_total IS NOT NULL
